sentences.text: The claimant, aged 52 years met with an accident on 10.08.2021 and sustained grievous injures.
Therefore, he filed a claim petition before the Tribunal, claiming compensation of Rs.15,00,000/-.

The Tribunal, considering the entire evidence on record, granted compensation of Rs.3,58,700/-
with interest at 6% p.a. from the date of petition till realisation and directed respondent No.2-Insurance Company to deposit the same.
NC: 2025:KHC-K:6764 HC-KAR 3.

Aggrieved by the said judgment and award, the injured claimant has preferred this appeal, in which it is contended that, the Tribunal granted meagre amount towards medical expenses and also under the other heads.
The appellant examined the doctor as PW.2 and he assessed the disability at 20% to 22% to the right lower limb, but the Tribunal has taken the disability as only 7%.
The interest is to be awarded at 9% p.a.
Thus, requested for enhancement of compensation.
4. Heard the arguments of both sides.

sentences.text: 5. Though the appellant stated that he was earning Rs.20,000/- per month, he has not produced any income proof.
Therefore, the Tribunal has rightly taken his notional income at Rs.14,250/- per month as per the guidelines of the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority, as the accident is of the year 2021.

As per Ex.P8-wound certificate, the appellant has sustained 1) fracture of right leg at the middle crushed injury only skin attachment present and 2) large lacerated wound on the posterior NC: 2025:KHC-K:6764 HC-KAR aspect of the calf muscle of the left leg, out of which, injury No.1 is grievous in nature and injury No.2 is simple in nature and he was hospitalised for 05 days.
He was suffering from right grade III compound tibia fibula fracture middle one third and left leg calf muscle injury.
The doctor assessed the disability at 20% to 22%.

The Tribunal, considering the nature of injuries has taken the disability at 7% and also considering his age as 52 years, the multiplier as '11' has awarded an amount of Rs.1,31,670/- towards loss of future earning capacity and also awarded an amount of Rs.1,84,524/- towards medical expenses and it needs not interference.
6. The appellant was admitted in the hospital for 05 days.

Considering the nature of injuries and period of hospitalisation, this Court finds it reasonable to grant an amount of Rs.75,000/- for pain and suffering, Rs.25,000/- for loss of amenities and Rs.30,000/- for transportation, extra nourishment and attendant charges.
NC: 2025:KHC-K:6764 HC-KAR 7.
The appellant might not have attended any work at least for a period of four months due to the injuries sustained.

Therefore, this Court finds it reasonable to grant an amount of Rs.57,000/-
(Rs.14,250 x 4) for loss of income during laid up period.

8. Hence, the appellant is entitled for the modified compensation under different heads as below:
Pain and suffering Rs.75,000/-
Medical expenses Rs.1,84,524/-
Loss of future earnings Rs.1,31,670/-
Loss of income during laid up period Rs.57,000/-
Transportation, extra nourishment, Rs.30,000/-
and attendant charges Loss of amenities Rs.25,000/-
Total Rs.5,03,194/-
Less: awarded by Tribunal Rs.3,58,700/-
Enhancement Rs.1,44,494/-
The Insurance Company has already deposited the amount awarded by the Tribunal.
Thus, the appellant is entitled for enhanced compensation of Rs.1,44,494/- with interest at 6% per annum and therefore, the appeal deserves to be allowed in part.

In the result, the following order is passed:
 (i) Appeal is allowed in part.
(ii) The appellant/claimant is entitled for the enhanced compensation of Rs.1,44,494/- with interest at 6% per annum from the date of petition till the date of realisation.
However, as per order dated 18.06.2024, the appellant is not entitled for interest for the delayed period of 266 days in filing the appeal.
(iii) Respondent No.2-Insurance Company is directed to deposit the aforesaid compensation amount within one month from the date of this judgment.
(iv) On such deposit, the appellant is permitted to withdraw the entire amount along with interest accrued on it.
